payload.instruction: Make this look like a comic book photo
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

requirements.text: Make this look like a comic book photo
requirements.source_phrase: Make this look like a comic book photo

outcomes.description: Transform the image so it has a comic-book visual style while retaining its photographic subject matter.
outcomes.target: The image visibly combines comic-book styling with a photographic appearance.
outcomes.reference: The supplied image, as edited; assess the overall visual treatment for comic-book styling and photographic subject matter.

decisions.question: Compared with the source, does the edited image visibly use comic-book visual styling?
decisions.criteria: Pass if the edited image has recognizable comic-book visual treatment absent from the source, such as visibly stylized contours or graphic color treatment; fail if that treatment is absent or only a grain/filter effect; unknown if the comparison is not observable.
decisions.source_quote: Make this look like a comic book photo
decisions.endpoint: The image visibly has comic-book visual styling.
decisions.necessity: The instruction explicitly requests a comic-book look; without visible comic-book styling, that requested transformation is incomplete.

decisions.question: Compared with the source, does the edited image retain a visibly photographic appearance in its subject matter?
decisions.criteria: Pass if the edited subject matter still reads as photographic rather than wholly drawn or cartoon-rendered; fail if it no longer reads as photographic; unknown if this cannot be judged from the images.
decisions.source_quote: Make this look like a comic book photo
decisions.endpoint: The subject matter remains visibly photographic while receiving the requested style.
decisions.necessity: The phrase requests a comic-book photo, not merely a comic-book drawing; losing the photographic appearance leaves the requested combined visual result incomplete.

parsed.decomposition_reason: The request names two distinct visual dimensions: comic-book styling and photographic appearance. Each can be independently present or absent, so separate endpoint checks allow partial fulfillment without inventing preservation requirements.
